name: Sraosha
description: The sleepless sentinel for Jellyfin. Vigilantly inspects Jellyseerr requests and re-triggers missing or stalled downloads in Radarr & Sonarr.
overview: Automated watchdog that monitors Jellyseerr for stalled requests and re-triggers downloads in Radarr and Sonarr.

versions.changelog: Initial release: Automated detection of stalled requests in Jellyseerr, multi-instance Radarr/Sonarr support, Trakt watch history integration, Webhook notifications, and native scheduled task & configuration page.
